analysis.summary: Bajaj Auto management reported a record-breaking performance for Q4 and FY26, driven by growth across all business units with revenues crossing INR58,000 crores and EBITDA crossing INR12,000 crores for the full year. For Q4 FY26, revenues reached INR16,006 crores with an EBITDA margin of 20.8%, supported by robust performance in sports motorcycles, exports, electric vehicles, and commercial vehicles. Management noted that the demand environment has softened in April due to general inflation, vehicle price hikes, and LPG shortages, with near-term motorcycle growth expected to moderate to 7% to 9%. To reward shareholders on the 100-year milestone of the Bajaj family, the board approved a payout of 100% of last year's profits via a final dividend and a tender buyback at INR12,000 per share. Bajaj Auto delivered a record financial and operating performance for FY2026, crossing 5 million in annual volumes and achieving standalone revenue of nearly Rs 59,000 crore alongside a standalone profit after tax of Rs 9,825 crore.

guidance.claim: Management expects near-term motorcycle industry growth to moderate to 7% to 9%.
guidance.quote: This is bound to slow down the motorcycle category from its rocking 20% growth in Q4 to we estimate 7% to 9% in the near term.

guidance.claim: The company expects the motorcycle industry to continue growing at 12% to 15%.
guidance.quote: We expect this growth momentum in the industry to continue and the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at, say, 12% to 15%.

guidance.claim: Management expects the export business to deliver its highest-ever top-line performance in USD terms this financial year.
guidance.quote: In fact, the business is on the path to deliver its highest ever top line performance in USD terms this financial year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus segment and specifically in the 150cc plus segment.
guidance.quote: Therefore, we expect to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus segment and particularly in the 150cc plus segment and continue on the path of market share acquisition, which has commenced a couple of months ago.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand environment softened in April due to general inflation, increased vehicle prices, LPG shortages, and manpower migration.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment, it has softened in April due to general inflation, increased prices of our vehicles, LPG shortages, manpower migration and the LPG shortage-led effect on the consumer sentiment.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric category in both 3-wheelers and 2-wheelers will witness continued growth and possibly a further increase in growth.
demand_outlook.quote: Secondly, the electric category in both 3-wheelers and 2-wheelers will witness not just continuity of growth, but perhaps a further increase in growth.

demand_outlook.claim: Latin America continues to outperform, delivering sustained growth for 11 consecutive quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: Latin America continues to outperform, delivering sustained growth for 11 consecutive quarters now and reporting another all-time high performance, driven by strong growth in almost each and every country.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the external environment remains volatile, uncertain, and complex due to geopolitical developments, commodity inflation, supply chain disruptions, and shifts in global trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: As we look ahead to FY2027, the external environment remains volatile, uncertain and complex. Geopolitical developments, commodity inflation, supply chain disruptions and shifts in global trade dynamics are creating challenges in the operating environment, that are particularly pronounced as we start the new financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: Post-GST rationalization, the industry grew by about 15% in Q3, and January is sustaining at a similar level.
demand_outlook.quote: And our understanding is that even January is sustaining at a similar level.

demand_outlook.claim: The top 30 overseas markets grew by about 10% in the quarter while the company's sales grew at 15%.
demand_outlook.quote: The top 30 overseas markets collectively accounting for nearly 75% of the emerging market, industry grew by about 10% in this quarter with our sales growing at 15%, thereby signalling an increase of market share in these key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Nigeria's sales doubled in Q3 compared to Q2, though it remained negative compared to Q3 of the previous year.
demand_outlook.quote: Nigeria, our largest market, doubled sales in Q3 compared to Q2, though it continued to be negative compared to previous year Q3.

demand_outlook.claim: The electric 3-wheeler segment continues to drive the 3-wheeler industry by growing at over 50%.
demand_outlook.quote: The Electric segment continues to drive the 3-wheeler industry by growing at about 50% plus.

capex_expansion.claim: Brazil manufacturing capacity has increased to 60,000 units per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Sales nearly 10,000 units during the quarter, supported by expanded manufacturing capacity, which has now increased to 60,000 units per annum, successful new product introductions like the 400 NS and wider market presence with almost 70 top-class stores.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.
capex_expansion.quote: Capex for the year was approximately INR500 crores, split equally between ICE and EV investments.

capex_expansion.claim: The company strategically invested slightly above INR 2,300 crores in the first 9 months into the Netherlands subsidiary BAIHBV and BACL.
capex_expansion.quote: We have strategically invested slightly above INR2,300 crores during this 9-month period into our Netherlands subsidiary, BAIHBV which you would recall was partly to fund the KTM acquisition and in the growth of BACL, which has steadily grown in scale and footprint.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has about 50 joint KTM-Triumph showrooms operational and plans to expand them to over 100 by March.
capex_expansion.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

margins_costs.claim: Material cost inflation for the upcoming quarter is estimated at approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.
margins_costs.quote: Taken together, we are currently estimating a material cost inflation impact of approximately 3.5% to 4% of revenue.

margins_costs.claim: Price increases have been implemented to offset about 40% of the material cost inflation impact.
margins_costs.quote: Once again, we have taken very judicious pricing actions to offset about 40% of this impact so far.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA crossed Rs 12,000 crore for the first time with EBITDA margins remaining robust at 20.5%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA crossed H 12,000 crore for the first time, while EBITDA margins remained robust at 20.5%, reflecting the disciplined and dynamic P&L management through the year, where every lever of judicious pricing, cost savings/ efficiencies, richer mix and operating leverage was brought into action to sustain the industry-leading margin performance alongside making competitive investments.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins expanded to 20.8%, which is up 30 basis points sequentially.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins expanded to 20.8%, up 30 basis points sequentially.

margins_costs.claim: The electric business now delivers double-digit EBITDA margin.
margins_costs.quote: More importantly, the EV business now delivers double-digit EBITDA margin while improving unit economics as the portfolio continues to scale.

margins_costs.claim: The net price versus cost inflation hit was nearly 50 basis points on the margin due to deferred pricing actions.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, we saw a net price versus cost inflation hit of nearly 50 basis points on the margin.

margins_costs.claim: A one-time exceptional charge of INR 61 crores was recognized towards past service cost arising from the new labour code.
margins_costs.quote: As you're all aware, pursuant to the amendment in the definition of wages under the new labour code, we recognized INR61 crores as a onetime exceptional charge towards the past service cost arising from the changes introduced under the new labour code.

orders_capacity.claim: Chetak capacity has now reached 50,000 units per month.
orders_capacity.quote: And we have now a capacity of 50,000 units per month.

orders_capacity.claim: Total volumes in Q4 reached a new high of 13.7 lakh units, growing 24% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: Total volumes reached a new high of 13.7 lakh units, growing 24% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: Export volumes crossed the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters.
orders_capacity.quote: The BU crossed the 200,000 average per month sales level in October '25 after nearly 40 months and maintained this level through the remainder of the quarter, surpassing the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains a 70% plus market share in the ICE 3-wheeler segment with an overwhelming share of 85% plus in the CNG segment.
orders_capacity.quote: We continue to maintain a 70% plus market share in the ICE segment with an overwhelming share of 85% plus in the CNG segment, which is the largest segment within ICE.

orders_capacity.claim: Combined volumes for KTM and Triumph reached over 35,000 units, registering robust growth of around 50% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: The 2 brands together delivered a record domestic performance with combined volumes of over 35,000 units, registering robust growth of around 50% year-on-year and marking the highest-ever quarterly performance for the business, lifted also by the positive sentiment.

capital_allocation.claim: The company closed the year with surplus funds of over INR18,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We closed the year with surplus funds of over INR18,000 crores after deploying capital on multiple fronts during the year, reflecting a strong and consistent cash generation.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a final dividend of Rs 150 per share and a share buyback through a tender offer route, with a combined payout amounting to Rs 9,825 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors have recommended a Final Dividend of J 150 per share and Share Buyback through tender offer route. The combined payout from the dividend and buyback amounts to J 9,825 crore, equivalent to 100% of the Profit after tax for the year.

capital_allocation.claim: The company closed the quarter with surplus cash of about INR 15,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to deliver strong and consistent cash generation, closing the quarter with surplus cash of about INR15,000 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: In the first 9 months of the year, the company generated nearly INR 5,200 crores of free cash flow, up 70% over the same period last year.
capital_allocation.quote: It's also worth noting that in the first 9 months of this year, we've generated nearly INR5,200 crores of free cash flow, and that was up 70% over the same period last year, reflecting our strong track record of converting profit to cash.

risks_headwinds.claim: Supply chain difficulties regarding LPG shortages, manpower availability, and outbound logistics have impaired availability to service demand by 10% to 15%.
risks_headwinds.quote: Supply chain difficulties in terms of the LPG shortage, manpower availability and outbound logistics to overseas markets have impaired availability to service demand by about 10% to 15%.

risks_headwinds.claim: The non-availability of rare earth magnets caused supply disruptions for the Chetak business in the first half of the year.
risks_headwinds.quote: Non-Availability of rare earth magnets, a consequence of export restrictions from China, created supply disruption in the first half, constraining volumes even as consumer demand remained strong.

risks_headwinds.claim: Precious metals including platinum, palladium, and rhodium saw sharp increases, while aluminium, copper, nickel, and lead continued to harden.
risks_headwinds.quote: Noble Metals especially platinum, palladium and rhodium all saw sharp increases, whilst aluminium, copper, nickel and lead also continued to harden.

risks_headwinds.claim: The withdrawal of PM E-DRIVE incentives in the electric 3-wheeler segment had a meaningful impact of approximately INR 23,000 to INR 25,000 per vehicle.
risks_headwinds.quote: While the withdrawal occurred towards the later part of the quarter, the impact was meaningful at approximately INR23,000 to INR25,000 per vehicle, and we consciously chose to hold pricing and absorb this impact in order to invest behind growth and accelerate volumes and our competitive position in this segment.

risks_headwinds.claim: The GST rate on motorcycles exceeding 350cc increased from 31% to 40%.
risks_headwinds.quote: You recall when we had last spoken, the GST rates on motorcycles in excess of 350cc had moved up from the 31%, which was essentially 28% GST rate plus 3% cess to 40%.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to move export volumes to 2,20,000 units per month this quarter.
management_commitments.quote: We are looking at moving the exports needle to 2,20,000 units per month this quarter, up from the 2,00,000 levels.

management_commitments.claim: New product introductions in the Pulsar brand are scheduled to hit the market starting in July.
management_commitments.quote: We'll have a new range in both the 125cc and the 150cc plus range. There will be hopefully, I think we will see these new introductions hitting the market as early as July in the Pulsar brand itself.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to move BMAG and KTM AG to quarterly reporting as a voluntary action to align with Bajaj Auto's reporting calendar.
management_commitments.quote: Going forward, it is our intention to move BMAG, KTM AG to quarterly reporting as a voluntary action to align with Bajaj Auto's reporting calendar and as a measure of good governance and transparency.

management_commitments.claim: The top management team exercise for KTM Austria will be completed by April 1st.
management_commitments.quote: The top deck is now largely in place, and the exercise will be completed by 1st April.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
